plainTranslation: A natural, easy fit between who one is and what the other needs. Drives and feelings sync; the relationship feels like home fast. Failure mode: comfort breeds passivity. Stay awake in it - easy compatibility still needs effort to become something.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryShort: Their sense of self and your feelings fit together comfortably.
summaryDeep: Their sense of self and your feelings fit together comfortably. You feel safe being yourself around them. This is real compatibility glue, so trust it.
tension: The problem is that easy can become lazy. Because the connection feels natural, both people may assume it will just keep going without much care.
advice: Don't sleep on the good thing just because it isn't causing problems. Keep showing up for it.
